# Independent Core System Colonies
The [bold]Independent Core System Colonies[/bold] (ICSC) are a loose union of self-governing human worlds, most of them in the [bold]New Eden Sector[/bold] of the Core Systems, with scattered holdings out in the Outer Veil and the frontier. Every ICSC world runs its own government, and many of those governments are overseen by corporations.
## History - The ICSC began as the [bold]Central Space Consortium[/bold], a network of corporate colonies under the [textlink="Three World Empire" link="CMUGuideLoreTWE"]. - In [bold]2148[/bold] the Consortium declared independence. Colonial Marines and Royal Marine Commandos were sent against its colonies and the fighting lasted until 2150. - The [bold]'51 New Deal[/bold], signed in 2151, handed many Colonies back to the TWE but recognized the rest of the Consortium as the self-governing ICSC.
## Government - The ICSC is ruled by a [bold]Board of Ministries[/bold] and keeps its own military, the [bold]ICSC Defense Force[/bold]. - Its [bold]EntaCOMM Network[/bold] lets its worlds (and anyone who pays them a pretty penny) communicate instantly across most of colonized space. - The ICSC holds very little influence on Earth, holding only small enclaves such as Persia, France, Korea, Turkey and Pakistan. - Most of human space doesn't accept the ICSC as a real government. To the superpowers, its members are secessionists, plain and simple. - Its neutrality between the great powers makes it the main source of [textlink="UNISC" link="CMUGuideLoreUNISC"] peacekeepers.
